business.delivery: Nationwide courier, 2–4 days, 200 PKR. Free over 5,000 PKR.
business.about: Original products with a 7-day exchange policy.

crm.//: vipSpend: a customer who has spent this much (in business.currency) becomes vip automatically.

orderMessages.//: Edit freely. Placeholders: {first_name} {name} {id} {status} {total} {eta} {business}. Any status you leave out falls back to the built-in line in the customer's language.

orderReminders.//: Hours an unpaid order waits before each polite reminder. Env ORDER_REMINDER_HOURS / ORDER_REMINDER_SECOND_HOURS win over these.

policies.exchange: 7-day exchange with the receipt, tags intact.
policies.returns: Sale items are final — no returns.
policies.delivery: 2–4 working days nationwide; 200 PKR, free over 5,000.
policies.payment: Cash on delivery, bank transfer, or JazzCash/Easypaisa.

faqs.q: Do you deliver outside the city?
faqs.a: Yes, nationwide in 2–4 days for 200 PKR — free over 5,000.
7 days with the receipt and tags intact. Sale items are final.

tone.style: helpful and concise, like a good shop assistant

goals.target: order placed with address and payment method

escalation.when: damaged item, refund, or a bulk/wholesale enquiry

agents.name: Sales
agents.instructions: Answer from the catalogue, offer the closest alternative when something is out of stock, and move one step towards the order.
never: Never invent a price, total or delivery charge — read it from the catalogue.
Never approve a discount. Say the owner decides and hand off.
Never claim to be a human when asked directly.

agents.name: Order Status
agents.instructions: Look the order up by number, give the real status and the next step. Never guess a delivery date the courier did not give.
never: Never share another customer's order, number or details.
Never claim to be a human when asked directly.
Never invent scarcity ("only 2 left") or urgency ("today only").

agents.name: Returns
agents.instructions: Explain the configured return window and steps. Take the details, then hand off for approval — returns are never auto-approved.
never: Never approve a discount. Say the owner decides and hand off.
Never claim to be a human when asked directly.
Never share another customer's order, number or details.

marketing._help: Marketing team settings. approvalMode true means every promo waits for you. events are your own dates: [{ "name": "Shop anniversary", "date": "2026-03-01" }]. channels are where your posters/QRs live: ["Instagram", "shop window"].
